gates.detail: Verified exact S60 commit/tree/parent, canonical delivery and all cited Git blobs. Windows working-tree raw hashes may differ from Git blob bytes due to line endings; manifest identities use Git blobs.

Finite event vocabulary includes phase/body-ready, complete application-frame send/receive, decode/state updates, one-batch-per-nonempty-layer, Select5 activity, output-share formation and escrow API events. Starts after successful package/preflight/lease/ideal-channel setup. Excludes arbitrary instruction, partial-byte, TLS-record, failure and real-time cuts. Max 89 logical phases for N<=256.

For every declared party/cut before local output-share formation, uses inherited S36/S50 conditional material kernel plus fixed-z_b conditional-law equality and marginalization. Does not supply future z_b to simulator. Base Beaver/material kernel is inherited, not re-proved by S61 reviewer.

Correct source order: P0 forms z0 then body u=z0 xor m0; P1 builds fixed ACK, receives/decodes full u, sends ACK, then XORs to form z1. Before z1 formation, P1 simulator samples u uniformly under fresh ideal refresh and receives no z1.
At and after own share-formation event only, corrupted party simulator may receive its own staged z_b as local state. This does not imply ciphertext submission, COMMITTED, fetch, or API return.

Incremental event-prefix extension uses S51 ideal token/Kpost kernel in causal order with honest peer and ideal A; does not truncate a completed transcript. Reviewer affirmed this extension under SuccessFence. S51 base token lemma and real escrow refinement are inherited/open, not independently re-certified.

First gap: FTv3 cap-abort has no joint kernel connecting the same invocation to package/context delivery, both parties' start permission and party-visible notice. Later ABORT/UNKNOWN/recovery-failure cut laws are not established. This is an unproved interface/model step, not an attack or impossibility result.

Owner decision needed on burning invocation and retrying only under a new invocation, paired failure/start notification, and whether abort states enter the theorem. Numeric algorithm random-failure deferral is not acceptance of FTv3 cap-abort.
SuccessFence is an exogenous ideal scheduling condition. No conditional sampler for real finite-timeout/wall-clock success selection is provided.
Actual deployment DRBG, signatures, recipient encryption, TLS/mTLS, SQLite/filesystem durability and runtime refinement are outside this ideal event-prefix proof.
No additional leakage fields, roles, inputs or outputs were introduced. Cut label J and scheduler sigma are proof-experiment inputs, not party-view leakage.
S61 prefix argument is limited to 1<=K<=N<=256.
No runtime or test source changed.
No build/tests and no S35/S40/S52 matrix rerun.
No natural I/O experiment this round; inherited evidence remains NOT_REPRODUCED.
